title: 第二十七章 癸水真经第二十八章 逃脱机会
content_zh:
“癸水真经”是癸水仙门最强大、最核心的仙法。
它与乙木仙门的“乙木引仙法”、丁火仙门的“丁火焚天诀”、己土仙门的“己土重岳功”、辛金仙门的“辛金破千军”同列为仙灵界最古老、最强大的仙法之一。
不知有多少人想要拜入这五大古老仙门，却没有一人寻得其五派山门所在。
“癸水真经”开篇有言。
“天有五行，水、火、金、木、土，分时化育，以成万物，相生相克，生生不息。然水为五行之基，其坚若金，其厚若土，其极可燃，其轻若气！”
五行相生相克，互为平衡方为五行，但在混沌之初时，也是有先有后而生的。
混沌先化水，水为万物之源，而后才是木、火、土、金的诞生，直至最后慢慢形成了相生相克平衡之态，伦循于天地之间，成就万物生长。
水为五行之基础，也为五行之首。
它若万古寒冰，其坚可比至刚坚金；它若千重重水，其重厚压山岳；它若极寒至阴，其极可燃万物；它若化雾为气，其翠木气盎然。
在这古老五大仙门中，其功法也是有强弱之分的，但这种强弱也只是表现在大乘期以下。
但此时并不像其他仙门功法，会冲击凝气期二层，而是需要继续修炼。
这是修仙界大忌，修仙，修仙，修的就是时间，不然短短的几十年还没修到筑基期，来不及进阶到下一阶增加寿元，就先已寿元耗尽而亡了。
除了圣灵根外，其他灵根都是多属性，但他们只会选择单修主灵根的功法，否则他们的修炼速度将会被拖延如龟速。
“大毒生灵术，大毒生灵，这应是一门修毒仙法或用毒仙法了，天不亡我，天不亡我啊，哈哈.”
地图上线条好似一幅路线图，几条不同的线路从地图几个方向向中心一处区域汇集，最后停留在了一处类似湖泊之地。
当把凝气期第一层最后金灵力也修炼出来后，就会形成一个生生不息的五行圆环。
季军师不由大喜，心道。
不动用法力还好些，一旦动用，便有种气息乱撞之感，刚才在外面他救治李言时，动用了几次法力，便感觉到气息已经不稳了。
故而五仙门择徒要求灵根属性强弱排列顺序，若其灵根不是按相生之道依次递减，那么在修炼功法后，上一属性灵力无法灌入相生灵力，导致灵力失衡逆冲，最后横死当场。
“坐吧！”

而修炼五仙门功法后，就会使本身灵力雄浑程度超出同阶数倍。
过了好一会，神识终于停留在了地图前，也并没有出现什么意外情况后，这才让他松了一口气。
“此书禁制难道已因岁月丢失，今日这颜色之变，应当就是禁制失效之力了。”
后面的每升一层境界时，体内的五行灵力都会以其他形式如此往复。
随后，他就看到了一幅意想不到的景象，书中是一片空旷的空间，正中央有一副悬于空中的地图，有些像随风扭曲的飘荡的画册。
李言缓缓睁开双眼，他依旧还在石屋之内，依旧盘坐于床上，只是脑中已多了一篇口诀。
修炼“癸水真经”，以水灵根为根基，每一层境界最后都是按五行相生之法修炼到平衡，则可进入下一境界。
远观时，可见其上面有几条弯弯曲曲的线条和一些标注。
如一杂灵根之人，他的水灵力感应最好，则需修炼“葵水真经”，但是他其他属性强弱感应却是火、土、金、木这样排列。
季军师呆呆的望着这几个字，过了好大一会后，不由口中喃喃自语。
修炼“癸水真经”开始则以最高的水属性那口缸为基础，修炼时如注水，当水灵力最后修炼到缸口处时，则水灵力缸满。
对于五仙门来说其实则不然，他们采用的就是相生之法，除了凝气期第一层需要从无到有修炼出五行法力之外。
第三个好处便是可以修炼不同灵力属性的功法，其他门派极少有同时修炼两种属性以上功法的。
书还是那两本被粘在一起的书，上面三分之一还是玉白色，一如既往，但下方三分之二的部分却已变成灰褐色，仿佛一下失去了光泽。
其上有几个一闪一闪血红字迹-——“大毒生灵术”
“却也不能把所有希望都压在那小子身上，只是这书被人设了高深禁制，嗯？”
他心中虽在想着事情，眼前景象却不由的让他一呆，下一刻，季军师从地上忽的一下站了起来。
他急忙把书籍拿到眼前细细观察，而后又几次反复调转书籍，从不同角度进行观看，最后还是确认书籍已经有了变化。
法力雄浑深厚，斗法持久时间更长，使用法术威力更大。
content_en:
"Guishui Zhenjing" is the most powerful and core immortal method of Guishui Immortal Sect.
It is one of the oldest and most powerful immortal arts in the fairy world, along with Yimu Immortal Sect's "Yimu Inducing Immortals Technique", Ding Huo Immortal Sect's "Ding Fire Burning Heaven Technique", Jitu Immortal Sect's "Jitu Chongyue Gong", and Xinjin Immortal Sect's "Xinjin Breaks Thousands of Army".
I don’t know how many people want to worship these five ancient immortal gates, but no one has found the location of the five ancient gates.
The opening chapter of "Guishui Zhenjing" contains some words.
"There are five elements in the sky, water, fire, metal, wood, and earth, which are transformed and nurtured in time to form all things. They are mutually reinforcing and interfering with each other, and they are endless. However, water is the foundation of the five elements. It is as strong as gold, as thick as earth, as extremely flammable, and as light as air!"
The five elements are mutually reinforcing and restraining each other, and they balance each other to form the five elements. However, in the beginning of chaos, they also came into being first and then later.
Chaos first transformed into water, which became the source of all things, and then came the birth of wood, fire, earth, and metal. Until finally, a state of mutual generation and mutual restraint and balance was gradually formed, and the ethics between heaven and earth allowed the growth of all things.
Water is the foundation of the five elements and the first of the five elements.
It is like eternal ice, its strength can be compared to the solid gold; it is like a thousand layers of water, its weight is heavy on the mountains; if it is extremely cold to the point of yin, it can burn all things; if it turns mist into air, its green trees are full of energy.
Among the five ancient immortal sects, their skills are also divided into strengths and weaknesses, but this strength is only shown below the Mahayana stage.
But at this time, it is not like other immortal sect skills that will impact the second level of Qi Condensation Stage, but needs to continue to practice.
This is a taboo in the world of cultivating immortals. Cultivation of immortals requires time. Otherwise, in just a few decades, before reaching the foundation-building stage and not having time to advance to the next level to increase lifespan, one would have exhausted his lifespan and died.
Except for the Holy Spirit root, other spiritual roots have multiple attributes, but they will only choose to practice the main spiritual root alone, otherwise their cultivation speed will be slowed down to a crawl.
"The Great Poison Life Technique, the Great Poison Life Creation Technique, this should be a method of cultivating poisonous immortals or using poisonous immortals. God will not destroy me, God will not destroy me, haha."
The lines on the map are like a road map, with several different routes converging from several directions on the map to a central area, and finally stopping at a lake-like place.
When the final golden spiritual power of the first level of the Qi Condensation Stage is also cultivated, an endless circle of the five elements will be formed.
The third division commander couldn't help but be overjoyed and thought to himself.
It would be better if he didn't use his magic power. Once he used it, there would be a sense of aura clashing. When he was treating Li Yan outside just now, he used his magic power several times and felt that his aura was already unstable.
Therefore, when selecting disciples of the Five Immortals Sect, the spiritual root attributes are required to be arranged in order of strength. If the spiritual roots are not decreasing in descending order according to the way of mutual generation, then after practicing the exercises, the spiritual power of the previous attribute cannot be poured into the spiritual power of mutual generation, resulting in an imbalance of spiritual power, and eventually death on the spot.
"Sit down!"
After practicing the Five Immortals Cultivation Techniques, one's own spiritual power will be several times more powerful than the same level.
After a while, his consciousness finally stopped in front of the map, and nothing unexpected happened, so he breathed a sigh of relief.
"Have the restrictions on this book been lost over time? Today's change in color should be the result of the ineffectiveness of the restrictions."
Each time you advance to a higher level, the five elements of spiritual power in your body will reciprocate in other forms.
Then, he saw an unexpected sight. The book was an empty space, with a map suspended in the air in the center, somewhat like a picture album twisting and floating in the wind.
Li Yan slowly opened his eyes. He was still in the stone house, still sitting cross-legged on the bed, but there was an extra mantra in his mind.
The practice of "Guishui Zhenjing" is based on the water spirit root. Each level of realm is finally balanced according to the method of the five elements, and then you can enter the next realm.
When viewed from a distance, you can see several winding lines and some markings on it.
For example, if a person with mixed spiritual roots has the best water spiritual power, he needs to practice the "Kui Shui Sutra", but his other attributesThe sexual strength induction is arranged like this among fire, earth, metal and wood.
The third division commander stared blankly at these words. After a long while, he couldn't help but murmur to himself.
The beginning of practicing "Guishui Zhenjing" is based on the vat with the highest water attribute. During practice, it is like pouring water. When the water spiritual power is finally cultivated to the mouth of the vat, the water spiritual power is full.
This is actually not the case for the Five Immortals Sect. They use the method of mutual generation, except that the first level of the Qi Condensation Stage requires the cultivation of the five elements of mana from scratch.
The third advantage is that you can practice techniques with different spiritual attributes. Very few other sects can practice techniques with more than two attributes at the same time.
The books were still the two stuck together. The upper third was still jade-white, as before, but the lower two-thirds had turned gray-brown, as if it had suddenly lost its luster.
There are several flashing blood-red writings on it - "The Great Poison Life Technique"
"But we can't put all our hopes on that kid. It's just that this book has been severely restricted, huh?"
Although he was thinking about something in his mind, the sight in front of him could not help but make him stunned. The next moment, Master Ji Jun suddenly stood up from the ground.
He hurriedly brought the book to his eyes and observed it carefully. He then turned the book around several times and looked at it from different angles. Finally, he confirmed that the book had changed.
The magic power is strong and deep, the fighting skills last longer, and the spells are more powerful.
